ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a single-phase AC power supply, labeled as 230 V, 50 Hz, connected to a single-phase fully controlled bridge. The DC-side load on the right is a DC motor equivalent circuit, containing a series inductor, a 2 Ω resistor, and a back electromotive force source labeled as 150 V; the arrow of the load current I0 points to the right at the upper wire. Reasoning: The problem gives I0 = 10 A, and the load inductance is sufficiently large, so the load current is continuous and the ripple can be ignored, and the average voltage of the inductor is 0. Writing the average KVL for the DC load according to the current direction in the figure, the average DC output voltage of the bridge is Vdc = I0 R - E = 10 × 2 - 150 = -130 V. For a single-phase fully controlled bridge under continuous current, the average output voltage is Vdc = (2Vm/π) cos(α), where Vm = √2 × 230 V. Therefore -130 = [2√2 × 230 / π] cos(α). Calculation gives cos(α) = -130 / (2√2 × 230 / π) ≈ -0.628, so α ≈ cos⁻¹(-0.628) ≈ 128.9°, approximately 129°.

method.method_draft: First identify from the image Vrms = 230 V, R = 2 ohm, E = 150 V, and the current direction I0 through the load. From the text use I0 = 10 A and continuous current. Compute the required average bridge DC voltage from the load KVL: Vdc = I0 R - E = 10*2 - 150 = -130 V. Then compute Vm = sqrt(2)*230 and set -130 = (2 Vm/pi) cos(alpha). Solve cos(alpha) = -130 / [(2 sqrt(2)*230)/pi], giving alpha approximately 129 degrees.

method.method_draft: After reading E = 150 V, R = 2 ohm, supply = 230 V rms, and I0 direction from the image, use I0 = 10 A from the question. Compute generated emf power E I0 = 150*10 = 1500 W and copper loss I0^2 R = 10^2*2 = 200 W. The net power delivered back to the bridge is 1500 - 200 = 1300 W, so with the current direction defined into the DC load, the bridge average DC voltage is Vdc = -1300/10 = -130 V. Then use Vm = sqrt(2)*230 and Vdc = (2 Vm/pi) cos(alpha) to get cos(alpha) about -0.628, hence alpha about 129 degrees.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧是单相交流电源，标注为 230 V、50 Hz，接入一个单相全控桥。右侧直流侧负载从桥的上端流向右侧，电流箭头标为 I0，负载中依次可见平波电感、2 Ω 电阻以及标注为 150 V 的直流电势源。题目给定 I0 = 10 A，且电感足够大，所以直流电流连续且近似无纹波。

再推理：电机处于电气制动状态，150 V 电势源向外提供的功率为 E I0 = 150 × 10 = 1500 W。电枢电阻铜耗为 I0^2 R = 10^2 × 2 = 200 W。因此送回变流桥的净功率为 1500 - 200 = 1300 W。由于图中 I0 方向按从桥流入直流负载定义，而实际净功率是从电机负载回送到桥，所以桥的平均直流电压 Vdc = -1300 / 10 = -130 V。

单相全控桥在连续电流时的平均直流输出电压为 Vdc = (2 Vm / pi) cos(alpha)，其中 Vm = sqrt(2) × 230 ≈ 325.3 V。因此 2 Vm / pi ≈ 207.1 V，cos(alpha) = -130 / 207.1 ≈ -0.628。故 alpha = cos^-1(-0.628) ≈ 128.9°，约为 129°。
